body: did you know: half the people who loved "blank space" missed the joke. taylor wrote it as satire of her own tabloid caricature -- only about half of listeners caught it, she has said. it then knocked her own "shake it off" off no. 1: a woman replacing herself, a hot 100 first.
why: X-native (text-only) sibling of the 1989 'Blank Space' did-you-know, keeping X active the same evening and filling the coldest era corner (1989 has zero recent coverage).
